purpose: external validation of immutable NR-only nonspinning33 amplitude calibration; no fitting
candidate_ranking: descending highest two available resolution labels, then ascending numericSXSID; freeze all ranks before newH5 downloads; advance only after earlier candidate fails NR-only fixed gates
primary: highest available Lev N3; same-level exact metadata; top2Lev N2/N3 each
splits: all external primaries holdout; supporting resolutions/orders validation_only; no training
quality_gate_reuse: unchanged screen_nr33_calibration_v2.screen_simulation with original pinned quality policy; original training/holdout count and targetgrid requirements do not apply to external-only validation
coverage_policy: report every requested target including absent/exhausted; validate all individually qualified targets even if coverage incomplete; never claim missing targets passed

agreement_reference.metric: relative amplitude L2 norm(A-B)/norm(B) using unchanged validator
agreement_reference.purpose: report whether prior subpercent observation extends; never a data-selection or refitting gate

numerical_controls: unchanged from frozen calibration and original qualitypolicy; no tuning; evaluate fixed0.95fring33-to0.3band
LAL_policy: validation only after quality screening; coefficient artifact already frozen; do not refit or select alternativeNR candidates based on fit or LAL residuals
runtime_policy: no runtime promotion or edits; retain MIT LICENSE; rawH5/NPZ outside repository
